name: hindsight
one_liner: A memory system you plug into any AI agent so it actually remembers what worked, what failed, and what a person told it last month, instead of starting from zero every conversation.
buyer: A team building a customer-facing AI product (support bot, coding assistant, personal assistant) that's losing users because the bot forgets everything between sessions.
business_use_cases: A customer support SaaS bolts it onto its chatbot so returning customers don't have to re-explain their account history every ticket.
An AI coding-assistant startup uses it to remember a team's coding conventions and past bug fixes across sessions instead of relearning them each time.
A personal AI assistant product uses it to remember a user's preferences (diet, schedule habits, recurring tasks) across months of use.

money_ideas.idea: Managed cloud memory service billed per agent or per million memory operations.
Integration consulting for enterprises bolting persistent memory onto an existing support or chat product.

steal_this: Wrap it around an existing open-source chatbot this weekend and sell it to one local business as 'a customer service bot that actually remembers your regulars.'
